Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about pricing/usage: teams want a single, clear answer on how free credits, reserved capacity, and burst allowances work during launches. Can we get a short playbook and point people to it? :point_up:

Samir (VP Product): Short bullets: credits = money only; reserved capacity = contractual throughput + SLA; burst = short token-bucket buffer on top of quotas. For anything beyond burst, file a Launch Support request.

Jamie (Finance): Confirming: promotional credits reduce invoices, they never modify technical quotas or SLAs. If Sales offers higher throughput in a deal, that must be documented in the contract (reserved capacity) and billed separately.

Priya (Customer Success): Customers confuse invoice credits with quota increases all the time. We should add a one-line FAQ in the console explaining the difference. Also include who to loop in (Sales/CS/Support).

Riley (Support): Triage checklist for launch requests: account ID, start/end time (tz), expected peak RPS, endpoints, SDK/lang, sample token, and fallback plan. Use the console "Launch Support" form to route to on-call. Template: https://console.redwood.example.com/launch-playbook :white_check_mark:

Zoe (Eng): SDK note: our clients respect 429 + Retry-After. Recommend exponential backoff with jitter and limit to 3 retries during a spike. Streaming or resumable upload is preferable for big workloads.

DevOpsBot: System config: default write QPS per account = 120 req/s. Burst token-bucket = +20% for 30s. Temp quota request endpoint: POST /admin/v1/temp_quota_request (returns request_id). Requires approver approval.

Samir (VP Product): Gating rules for auto-approve: <= 40% above base QPS for <= 7 minutes and risk_score < 50. Anything else is manual review and needs CS/Sales sign-off. We'll publish this in the docs and add a console explainer.

Marcus (Legal): Reminder: any contractual throughput guarantees must be signed-off by Legal and Sales. Don't promise quota uplifts in PRs or one-off emails without SOW.

Ava (CEO): Action items: 1) publish a one-line console FAQ card and link to the Launch Playbook (Priya/Samir), 2) add a one-click Launch Support button in console (ENG ticket), 3) Sales/CS get the billing blurb (Jamie). Please share drafts in #product by EOW. Closing this thread unless objections. :rocket:
